description: WP-O5 Codex: Orks (11e) — an army built with codex enhancements in the real browser Army Builder reaches the game. Game-side half of the builder end-to-end; 40k/tests/run_ork11e_builder_cloud.sh runs both halves on one local relay server: server/tests/e2e-orks-codex.mjs drives the builder page (Playwright) — faction Orks, detachment Taktikal Brigade, a warlord Warboss whose Enhancement dropdown offers the codex Kill Kommanda (no pre-codex Skwad Leader / Mek Kaptin / Mork's Kunnin'), Kommandos offered only the Throat-slittas Upgrade, both picked; Madcap Meks: Temperamental Shokka / Enhanced Runt-maw offered to (and picked for) the Big Mek with Shokk Attack Gun, not a plain Big Mek — and saves the Taktikal army to the cloud as WPO5_E2E_Orks (the driver points res://server_config.json at that server for this run only). No fixture: the scenario runs on the MainMenu. A real click on Refresh Cloud Armies lists the army, it is selected for Player 1, a real click on Start Game downloads it and starts the game: the codex module recognises Kill Kommanda and Throat-slittas (the exporter's 'Throat Slittas' spelling folds the same), army validation is clean, the Kommandos' melee has [LETHAL HITS] vs INFANTRY, and the Battle Formations dialog offers the Kommandos as a bodyguard for the Warboss (LEADER: KOMMANDOS) — picked in its leader dropdown, and a real click on Confirm Formations records Warboss -> Kommandos. Not runnable without the driver's relay server.

steps.comment: the driver's temporary res://server_config.json points at the e2e relay server

steps.script:
var main = tree.current_scene
var idx := -1
for i in range(main.army_options.size()):
	if str(main.army_options[i].id) == "WPO5_E2E_Orks":
		idx = i
main.player1_dropdown.select(idx)
main.player1_dropdown.item_selected.emit(idx)
main.player1_type_dropdown.select(0)
main.player1_type_dropdown.item_selected.emit(0)
main.player2_type_dropdown.select(0)
main.player2_type_dropdown.item_selected.emit(0)
return main.player1_dropdown.get_item_text(main.player1_dropdown.selected).contains("Cloud")
steps.comment: Player 1 picks the cloud army in the dropdown; both seats human
the cloud army's Warboss and Kommandos are in the game
the codex module recognises both (Kill Kommanda on the Warboss; the exporter's 'Throat Slittas' spelling folds to Throat-slittas)
no codex Ork enhancement warning (bearers legal, Upgrade on a non-CHARACTER)
Throat-slittas in force: the Kommandos' melee has [LETHAL HITS] against an INFANTRY target (the attack-modifier hook every resolver reads)
the Battle Formations dialog offers the Kommandos as a bodyguard for the Kill Kommanda Warboss (LEADER: KOMMANDOS)
pick the Kommandos in the Warboss's leader dropdown
FormationsPhase recorded P1's leader attachment Warboss -> Kommandos (DECLARE_LEADER_ATTACHMENT accepted); P2's dialog is next
